text_block_list.text:
One day, when returning with Daiichi Ruby
from an outing...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am going to the amusement park for personal business.
If it is not an inconvenience, I would be honored
if you could accompany me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Are you going out to play?
Are you going out to have fun?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No.
I will explain the details once we arrive on site.

Hearing that, and having no other plans,
I took her up on the offer and headed to the amusement park with her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, I have been invited to a party
with an entrepreneur I am acquainted with.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"What that person is currently focusing on
is the construction of a leisure facility for young people."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "If I can provide accurate advice on this occasion, we will be able to build a favorable relationship going forward. That is why I came all the way here."
choice_data_list: So, why did you drag me along too?
So, why did you bring me along too?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Because we want to gather honest feedback from people who have actually used the leisure facilities.

Regardless, I am glad to be relied upon.
I shall help out with all my might!
Big sis! Hurry! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, don't wander off on your own!
If you run around too much, you're gonna trip~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ruby-chan and her Trainer!
What a coincidence bumping into you here!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good day, Ines-san.
âIf I recall, Daiichi Ruby said she wanted opinions from younger folks. Since they're here, why not ask for their help?
choice_data_list: Why don't we ask them for help?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Ines, there is something I would like to consult you about—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I see!
If that's the case, I'll help out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Going around in a big group makes it lively and fun,
and I'm sure my little sisters will love it too♪

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah!! Big sisteerrr!!
The zombies are here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!? H-Hold on a second!
I don't need updates like that!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! Sis, look, look!
The way that skeleton's walking! Those bones are going wild!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaah!?
Jeez! Stop teasing your big sister~!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So rather than just enjoying the prepared scares, the experience can develop and expand depending on what your companion does.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! Running feels just like
flying through the sky, it's so great!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!! That feels amazing!!
Yaaaay!! That feels amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Simultaneously sharing sensations like fear and exhilaration—
it appears a sense of unity is achieved through empathy.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun!
I wanna ride the roller coaster again!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's been so long since I saw
those kids having so much fun~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It was thanks to the two of them! I'm sure it was fun because we got to tour the amusement park in a big group!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
So headcounts are also quite important.
Thank you very much for your valuable feedback.
choice_data_list: Ruby, you've never had that kind of experience before?
Ruby, haven't you ever had an experience like that?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you are asking whether I have ever visited an amusement park,
yes, I have.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We were invited by a corporation for an inspection tour.
If I recall correctly, I looked around with my butler.

Could it be that she's never had fun at an amusement park before...?
Even today, she dedicated herself entirely to observing.
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, why don't you have some fun too?
Since you're here, why don't you enjoy yourself too?
Is the data collection going well?

text_block_list.text:
Could it be that she's never had fun at an amusement park before...?
Even today, she dedicated herself entirely to observing.
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, why don't you have some fun too?
Since you're here, why don't you enjoy yourself too?
Is the data collection going well?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see no necessity for it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned,
our goal is to gather opinions from the general public.

I understand what she's saying, but...
It leaves me feeling somewhat worried about her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was able to obtain detailed impressions
for each of the attractions.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This is also a valuable result achieved through the dedicated efforts of Ines-san and the others.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I would be honored to send a token of my gratitude at a later date.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If anyone in your family has any allergies,
please do let me know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~.
Going that far for me kinda makes me feel bad~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's a thank-you gift, after all.
I'll gladly accept it!

A few days later, Ines Fujin told me that a lavish box of sweets
had arrived, and her whole family thoroughly enjoyed sharing it.
